findings.issue: SCR-14 has two rows each for Empty, Loading, Error and No access: sourced content, then 'Not specified', which contradicts it.
SCR-30 has the same duplicate, contradictory state rows.
AC6 calls the consumed event 'Not specified', but §12 names it: rwb.decision.DecisionRecorded.v1.
AC7 calls the refusal message 'Not specified', but X5 gives 409 and MSG-P5-002 for any change to a sent document.
§5 Covered by omits new AC5 for the send-log failure (X6) and AC7 for a change to a sent document (X5).
'run by Not specified' contradicts this harness running its own ITG tests. The unknown is the legacy criterion owner. TC-04 also lacks the marker.
